name: Ward of Radiance
text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at your location draws a non-weakness treachery card.
Reveal 5 random chaos tokens from the chaos bag. If a [bless] or [elder_sign] token is revealed, cancel that treachery card's revelation effect.
text_cn:
快速。你所在地点一位调查员在抽取一张非弱点诡计卡时打出。
从混乱袋随机抽出5个混乱标记。
如果抽出[bless]或[elder_sign]标记，取消该诡计卡的显现效果。
